description: Trip720's researched facts for one destination, for travellers who live in Australia or the UK: what a day costs one person for food and local transport (street food, balanced, mostly restaurants), taxi prices, tourist tax, the most pleasant months, the visa for that home country, the sights not to miss with tips, and the total of a sample priced trip, with the sources of the costs. Amounts are in AUD or GBP. Use it for questions about what a place costs or what to see there. Read only: no search or booking is made. A place Trip720 has not covered says so and lists the covered places in that country.
